subject: SummitPath onboarding - security packet, subprocessor list, and PO routing
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@summitpath.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@summitpath.com
Date: Tue, 28 May 2028 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding kickoff — security evidence, subprocessor list, and PO routing

Hi Irene / Jordan,

Thanks for the demo last week — SummitPath is ready to start procurement and we need a few items to pass our vendor gate and issue a PO:

- Executed DPA or the DPA document we can route for signature
- SOC 2 report (or link to the report and evidence host)
- Current subprocessor list (CSV or sheet with vendor name + function + country)
- Standard purchase order instructions (invoice address, AP contact, remit-to, any tax IDs)

I've attached our procurement kickoff form (SummitPath_Procurement_Kickoff_Form.xlsx) with fields our AP team needs. If you can confirm where we should send the PO and whether Redwood needs a specific invoice reference, that'd speed things up.

Also looping our AP contact (procure@summitpath.com). We need to get this over the finish line by EOD Friday to align with our fiscal month close.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call if easier.

Best,
Samantha Li
Vendor Operations | SummitPath
[Attachment: SummitPath_Procurement_Kickoff_Form.xlsx]

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@summitpath.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding kickoff — security evidence, subprocessor list, and PO routing

Samantha — thanks for the clear checklist and the form. We can get this moving. Quick answers up front:

- DPA: we maintain a current DPA (Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf). I can either send the PDF for your legal team to review or initiate a DocuSign route. Which do you prefer?
- SOC 2: our latest SOC 2 report is posted here: https://redwood-inference.security/soc2/2027-report. We can provide a read-only Drive folder for any auditors if required.
- Subprocessors: I will attach our canonical subprocessor extract (CSV) and a short mapping table showing primary function.
- PO / invoicing: Please send PO to procure@redwood.ai. Invoices should reference the PO number and be sent to ap@redwood.ai; remit-to is Redwood Inference, 1205 Market St., San Francisco, CA 94103. Redwood's tax ID (EIN) is 12-3456789 (please confirm if you need W9).

I am attaching the DPA and the subprocessors extract for your packet. Jordan — looping you in for any procurement-specific routing or billing exceptions.

Irene Choi
Senior Manager, Vendor Programs
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf]
[Attachment: Redwood_Subprocessors_2028-05.csv]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@summitpath.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: ap@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 May 2028 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding kickoff — security evidence, subprocessor list, and PO routing

Hi Samantha — Jordan here from Contracts & Ops. Thanks for sending the kickoff form. A few operational notes to make PO processing smoother:

1) PO submission: please send the signed PO PDF to procure@redwood.ai and include the SummitPath account name + Redwood deal id (RDW-SUM-28) in the subject line.
2) Invoice processing: invoices go to ap@redwood.ai. We require the PO number, invoice date, line-item descriptions, and Redwood billing contact. If SummitPath needs e-invoicing (Peppol) let us know and we'll provide the connection details.
3) DPA signature path: Irene can route the DPA via DocuSign. If SummitPath's legal needs minor edits, mark them in the DPA PDF and we will triage.
4) Subprocessors: attached is our canonical extract and a short README with last-updated timestamp. If you need function-level mapping to your internal categories, say which fields in your kickoff form we should populate and we will return a mapped CSV.

Attachments I'm sending to this thread: Redwood_Subprocessors_2028-05.csv, Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf, Redwood_PO_Instructions.pdf

Irene — one ask: for faster PO turnarounds, can we accept a provisional MSA reference on the PO and finalize the DPA as a separate signed exhibit? SummitPath internal policy?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Contracts & Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: Redwood_Subprocessors_2028-05.csv; Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf; Redwood_PO_Instructions.pdf]

Irene / Jordan — great, thanks for the fast turnaround. Our next steps: 

- I'll route the SummitPath procurement kickoff form internally and submit the PO to procure@redwood.ai today with the subject: "PO for SummitPath — RDW-SUM-28".
- We prefer DocuSign for the DPA, so if you can start the envelope (Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf) that would be ideal.
- For SOC 2, the link you provided is sufficient for our audit intake; we may request the read-only Drive folder for the auditor next week — I'll follow up if so.
- Subprocessor mapping: I'll attach your CSV to our vendor gate ticket. If our AP needs the EIN/W9, we'll request that separately.

If you need anything else from our side (PO number format, invoice reference field), let me know. Otherwise expect the PO and Docusign acknowledgement from me within a few hours.

Appreciate the help — looking forward to getting SummitPath live.

Best,
Samantha Li
Vendor Operations | SummitPath
